'''Anima''' was the part of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that, according to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], gave life&mdash;but not thought&mdash;to animals, plants and living beings. [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|Midi-chlorians]] induced and sustained anima in almost all [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] abilities were tied to anima.
